text:
Counting the almonds on the plate gives roughly 30. That includes about 25 in the cluster plus a few scattered ones.

A single almond weighs about 1.2 g, so 30 almonds come to about 36 g.

Almonds have about 5.8 kcal per gram, so 36 g is about 209 kcal.
